SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.nickname AS user_name, u.avatar_url AS avatar_address, u.level AS grade, u.signature AS introduce, COALESCE(s.video_count, 0) AS video_number, COALESCE(s.follower_count, 0) AS fans_number, CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS followed FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN user_stats s ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_follow f ON f.follower_id = #{viewerId} AND f.followee_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.status = 1 AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.follower_count, 0) DESC, u.id DESC
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.follower_count, 0) ASC, u.id DESC
ORDER BY u.level DESC, u.id DESC
ORDER BY u.level ASC, u.id DESC
ORDER BY u.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT keyword, search_count AS searchCount FROM search_keyword WHERE search_count > 0 ORDER BY search_count DESC, keyword ASC LIMIT #{limit}
